delete.description:
Into the trash. A message already there answers `409`: delete it
with `permanent=true`.

post.description:
Send from the account's address. The service sets From, Date and
Message-ID and keeps a read copy in the sent folder. `200` means the
mail server accepted the message; it cannot be taken back.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Sent again with the same key within 24 hours, the request returns the first result instead of sending twice. The same key with a different message answers `409`.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Secrets such as `password`. Stored encrypted, never returned.

AccountFailure.title: AccountFailure
AccountFailure.description: An account that could not answer, in a list across accounts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings to change, merged into the current ones; `null` removes one. E.g. `smtp_host`, `smtp_port`, `smtp_security` for sending.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: New secrets such as `password`. Stored encrypted, never returned.

AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate
AccountUpdate.description: What ``PATCH`` changes. Fields left out stay as they are.

message.description: After an update, the message as it is now.

BatchResult.title: BatchResult
BatchResult.description: One result per id, in the order of the request.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One way to connect an address, as found by one source.

CredentialInfo.title: CredentialInfo
CredentialInfo.description: That a credential is stored, never its value.

CredentialKind.title: CredentialKind
CredentialKind.description: What to ask the person for.

Discovery.title: Discovery
Discovery.description: Ranked ways to connect an address, best first.

bcc.title: Bcc
bcc.description: Receive it, but appear in no header.

DraftMessage.title: DraftMessage
DraftMessage.description:
A draft: a message that may still lack recipients. The service sets
From, Date and Message-ID.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error the API raises itself.

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Whether the folder is subscribed on the server (IMAP). Mail clients such as Outlook show only subscribed folders, and the inbox always. Null where the provider has no subscriptions.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The folder to create it in. Left out: the top.

FolderRole.title: FolderRole
FolderRole.description: Special-use role, after RFC 6154 and JMAP.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The new parent. `null` moves it to the top.

FolderUpdate.title: FolderUpdate
FolderUpdate.description: Rename or move a folder. Fields left out stay as they are.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: Rights on accounts: operation or group names, account ids or ``*``.

Hint.title: Hint
Hint.description: Something the person has to know or do, with a help page if known.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Every account the caller may act on, with its operations

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Operations not bound to one existing account

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The caller and its effective rights.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: What the caller may do on it

MeAccount.title: MeAccount
MeAccount.description: An account the caller may act on.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Further flags, named as in JMAP: `$answered`, `$forwarded`, `$draft`, and the provider's own keywords.

permanent.title: Permanent
permanent.description: For `delete`: for good instead of into the trash.

MessageBatch.title: MessageBatch
MessageBatch.description: One action for up to 100 messages of one account.

MessagePage.title: MessagePage
MessagePage.description:
Messages across accounts. ``incomplete`` names the accounts that did
not answer; their messages are missing from this page.

forward_as.title: Forward As
forward_as.description: `inline`: quoted with its headers, its attachments attached. `attachment`: the unchanged original as `message/rfc822`. Ignored for replies.

MessageReference.title: MessageReference
MessageReference.description:
Reply to or forward a message of the same account. The service sets
the recipients of a reply where none are given, the subject prefix,
In-Reply-To, References and the quote.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Further flags, named as in JMAP: `$answered`, `$forwarded`, `$draft`, and the provider's own keywords.

folder_ids.title: Folder Ids
folder_ids.description: The folders the message is to be in. A change moves it; the id stays. An IMAP message is in exactly one folder.

MessageUpdate.title: MessageUpdate
MessageUpdate.description: What ``PATCH`` changes on a message. Fields left out stay as they are.

bcc.title: Bcc
bcc.description: Receive it, but appear in no header.

OutgoingMessage.title: OutgoingMessage
OutgoingMessage.description:
A message to send. The service sets From, Date and Message-ID. It
needs a recipient, unless it is a reply: that finds one in the original.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Group name to the operations it allows

Role.title: Role
Role.description: A named, reusable set of grants.

Security.title: Security
Security.description: Encryption of a mail server connection. Plain text is never offered.

message_id_header.title: Message Id Header
message_id_header.description: The Message-ID of the sent message.

sent_copy_id.title: Sent Copy Id
sent_copy_id.description: The copy in the sent folder, where the service put one.

refused.title: Refused
refused.description: Recipients the server refused while it accepted others.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token itself. Shown this once only.

User.title: User
User.description: Someone or something that calls the API.
